title: Use the runnable relay carrier when classifying a mailbox revalidation hold
outcome: Mailbox revalidation error classification and direct-send refusal capture select the same runnable relay carrier even behind retained history.
acceptance: The error handler in revalidate_queued_mailbox_wakeups_before_dispatch selects a relay carrier using ordinary_queue_position, or an explicit documented contract explains and tests a deliberate late-only classification.
A behavioral regression with a non-runnable historical front and refused runnable relay behind it discriminates the early revalidation hold path while preserving the late authority check.
